subject: Post-call: deployment path & evidence needs (HIPAA / SOC2) - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisphere.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — deployment options and evidence checklist

Laura — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the compliance constraints that will determine your deployment path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Summary of what we heard:
- You will be processing PHI in production and require a signed BAA.
- Primary data residency: US; some customers in CA so regional routing preference is required.
- Audit window: you need 12 months of immutable audit logs for model invocations and admin actions.
- Required artifacts to accelerate procurement: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), encryption-at-rest details, KMS/HSM options, and network isolation diagram.

What this implies for deployment mode:
- Hosted API (fastest): supported but will require BAA, region pinning, and a discussion about retention limits and log export for your auditors. Good fit if you want minimal ops and can accept multi-tenant physical infra with logical isolation and strict contractual controls.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): recommended if you want predictable throughput and clearer tenant isolation; we can offer dedicated GPU pools + stricter network egress rules — reduces blast radius and makes compliance reviews simpler.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): recommended if your legal or procurement insists on customer-managed networks or air-gapped environments. This is higher-touch (installation window, infra approval) but provides the strongest assurance for audits.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Can you share the completed security questionnaire and the PHI scope spreadsheet (we need to map which endpoints will receive PHI)? — I attached our Redwood evidence request template for reference.
2) Which internal team will own the BAA negotiation and procurement timeline? Please loop them in (we can sync with Marissa on procurement terms).
3) Confirm whether 12 months of immutable logs is a hard requirement or a target — this affects retention cost and storage architecture.
4) If Dedicated is appealing, we can provision a staging cluster for evaluation (2–3 week lead time). If Private, we'll need to calendar a technical kickoff to scope network/firewall work.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf (internal copy for your audit team) — will share via secure link after you confirm the HubSpot contact.

Thanks — I’ll hold on provisioning until we get your PHI scope and procurement POC.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisphere.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment options and evidence checklist

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming the key points from our side:
- We will definitely require a signed BAA (our legal team flagged this as mandatory for PHI).
- SOC 2 Type II is acceptable as primary evidence; our security team will want to review the full report and control matrix.
- 12 months immutable audit logs is a hard requirement for our compliance program.
- Data residency: US-only routing is required; we may want specific region pinning (us-west preferred).

Attaching the security questionnaire and a PHI scope spreadsheet (both attached). The spreadsheet calls out which endpoints will receive PHI and expected throughput (peak 120 req/s).

Procurement POC: Raj Patel (cc’d) will own procurement and contract review. He’ll need your standard Dedicated pricing sheet and any uplift for regional isolation.

Can you confirm: if we choose Dedicated, does Redwood support bringing our own KMS key (BYOK) for at-rest encryption? Also, what’s the expected lead time to provision a dedicated GPU cluster for staging?

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Security & Compliance
MediSphere Health
laura.chen@medisphere.com

Attachments: Medisphere_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, Medisphere_PHI_Scope.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisphere.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medisphere.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment options and evidence checklist

Laura / Raj — great, thanks for the quick turn. A few answers and proposed timeline: 

1) BYOK: yes — Dedicated and Private both support customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, Azure Key Vault). For Hosted API we offer envelope encryption with Redwood-managed keys by default; BYOK is available on Dedicated and Private. We’ll document key rotation and access controls in the evidence bundle.

2) Provisioning lead times:
- Dedicated staging cluster (2x A100-equivalent): typically 10–15 business days after contract sign + network allowlist.
- Private (VPC deployment): technical kickoff + infra approval typically pushes delivery to 4–8 weeks depending on customer network clearance.
- Hosted: available immediately after BAA + account setup (hours–1 business day).

3) Audit artifacts we will share (initial bundle): Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf, network isolation diagram, KMS integration notes, sample retention/export procedure for audit logs. We can add an export of raw invocation logs (s3 export) for your auditors; we’ll need your log retention destination and access method.

Next steps (action items):
- Ben: upload the SOC2 and network diagram to the Drive folder and share secure link. (ETA EOD Mon)
- Marissa: prepare Dedicated pricing and a sample SOW for a staging cluster. (Marissa, Raj will be primary contact for procurement)
- Raj: please confirm desired contract term (12 / 24 / 36 months) and any required PO references.
- Laura: confirm whether you want us to prioritize Dedicated staging or a Hosted pilot while procurement completes. Hosted pilot can be used to validate functionality quickly while Dedicated is procured.

I’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth for evidence and provisioning notes.

—
Ben

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medisphere.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisphere.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment options and evidence checklist

Thanks — confirms we will pursue Dedicated for production. A few procurement notes:
- Contract term: targeting 24 months with an initial staging commit for 3 months.
- Please include pricing options for 24-month and 36-month terms and any volume discounts tied to committed GPU-hours.
- For the audit team: we’ll need the SOC2 report and the KMS/HSM attestation in PDF. Please add those assets to the Drive folder and share a secure link to Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf.

Marissa — can you send the Dedicated pricing and a sample SOW to procurement@medisphere.com? We’d like the staging cluster provisioned within the 10–15 business day window after contract signature.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Raj Patel
Procurement Manager
MediSphere Health
procurement@medisphere.com
